segments.text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.

footnotes.text: + shew her: Heb. make her know

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.

footnotes.text: + infamous…: Heb. polluted of name, much in vexation

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: In thee have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: ¶ Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken it, and will do it.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.

footnotes.text: + shalt take…: or, shalt be profaned

segments.text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.

footnotes.text: + dross of silver: Heb. drosses, etc

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.

footnotes.text: + As…: Heb. According to the gathering

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.
¶ And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.
